        <data source="affiliates"><label>Affiliates</label></data>
        <data source="website"><label>Official website</label></data>	
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:FanPodcast|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>

===Usage instructions===
'''Per notability guidelines, only for use with fan podcasts that meet the fan organization notability requirement of Lucasfilm affiliation or having hosted at ''Star Wars'' Celebration.''' Paste the following code at the beginning of the article, filing all relevant fields. If a field doesn't apply, just leave it blank.

'''The "website" field of the infobox must be formatted as a shortened url, like this: [https://example.com example.com]. However, if the website as a name, such as [[John Jackson Miller]]'s website "Faraday Press", then the field must be formatted like this: [https://farawaypress.com Faraway Press]. If the name of the website is the same name as the entity which is the subject of the article, revert to using a shortened url.'''<br />
